title: EmboTrap ® II Revascularization Device (Neuravi) in Acute Ischemic Stroke
official: Multicentric Observational Prospective Study on the Use of the EmboTrap ® II Revascularization Device (Neuravi) in Acute Ischemic Stroke
summary: The primary aim of Registrap study is to assess the safety and effectiveness of the EmboTrap®II Clot Retriever device (Neuravi) in patients with acute ischemic stroke from large vessel occlusion.

interventions.name: Mechanical thrombectomy with EmboTrap ® II Device

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Signed Informed Consent Form
* Large Vessel Occlusion on CTA or MRA in the Anterior or Posterior Proximal Cerebral Vasculature up to A1, M1, Dominant M2, P1
* ASPECTS ≥ 6
* Mismatch or good collaterals showed at MR or multiphasic CTA or pCT
* Groin Puncture performed within 12 hours from symptom onset
* Use of EmboTrap® II Revascularization Device (Neuravi) as the first or second line treatment

Exclusion criteria

* Informed consent not given
* Extracranial or tandem occlusion
